description: We are a team of students from Bahrain who are interested in space, technology, and finding creative solutions to real problems. Our project, BATHRA, uses NASA data to help farmers make better planting decisions and save resources. We enjoy teamwork, learning new skills, and sharing ideas. We welcome creative and motivated members who are interested in coding, design, research, or agriculture.
summary: BATHRA is a web-based prototype that helps farmers explore crop choices using NASA Earth observation data. It compares two planting plans, such as repeating the same crop or rotating crops, and shows factors like estimated water needs, crop diversity, temperature suitability, and possible environmental risks. Farmers can also explore hotter or drier conditions to see how different choices may perform. BATHRA aims to make satellite data easier to understand and use, supporting more informed farming decisions in Bahrain and other regions.
details:
BATHRA is a prototype website designed to help farmers make more informed crop-planning decisions. Users can compare different planting plans, including repeated planting and crop rotation. The comparison considers estimated water demand, crop diversity, temperature suitability, and possible environmental risks. Users can also explore hotter or drier conditions.

Our project uses NASA Earth observation data to connect satellite information with practical farming questions. The website presents the information in a simple format so users can explore options without needing specialist knowledge. We designed BATHRA with farmers’ needs in mind, including water use and changing climate conditions. Its intended impact is to support thoughtful crop planning and encourage more sustainable agriculture.
